About the Event

Join the CodeChef VITC Student Chapter for Hack Day, a full-day, in-person event bringing competitive programming.

HackDay is a unique and exciting competitive programming and problem-solving event designed to challenge participants on their coding skills, logical thinking, algorithms, and technical knowledge through multiple rounds.

Date: Friday, October 16, 2026
Time: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM IST
Venue: VIT Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Mode: Offline 
Organized by: CodeChef VITC Student Chapter
WhatsApp Group for Participants: https://chat.whatsapp.com/EsY886owlqX59XsyZLCXCv

Competitive Programming Challenge

Test your problem-solving skills in a timed, team-based competitive programming contest hosted by the CodeChef VITC Student Chapter.

Participants will solve algorithmic problems ranging from warm-ups to challenging problems requiring efficient algorithms and logical reasoning.

  • Team Size: Teams of exactly 2 members
  • Duration: The competitive programming contest will take place during the hack day. The exact contest start time, end time, and problem count will be communicated by the organizers.

Programming Languages: C++, Java, Python, and many other supported languages.

Topics Covered:

  • Data Structures and Algorithms
  • Dynamic Programming
  • Graph Algorithms
  • Greedy Algorithms
  • Mathematics and Logical Reasoning
  • Other algorithmic problem-solving techniques

Scoring: Rankings will be determined by the number of problems solved and penalty time. Participants should aim to submit correct and efficient solutions within the contest duration.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all university students.
  • Participation is subject to approval by the organizers due to limited seats.
  • All team members must register individually through the registration form.
  • Participants must follow the team-size requirements.

Inter-college participation: Students from other colleges are eligible to participate. Inter-college teams are permitted, subject to the applicable team-size requirements.

Inter-specialization participation: Students from different branches and specializations may participate together, provided they satisfy the eligibility and team-size requirements.

Event Schedule

9:00 AM – 6.30 PM - Event Duration

Note: The schedule is subject to minor changes at the organizers' discretion.

Rules and Regulations

  • Participants must complete individual registration and receive confirmation of selection from the organizers.
  • Participants must check in at the venue and follow the instructions provided by the organizing team.
  • Teams must adhere to the prescribed team-size.
  • For the Competitive Programming Challenge, participants must adhere to the contest rules, submission guidelines, and time limits announced by the organizers.
  • Competitive programming rankings will be based on problems solved and penalty time, subject to the contest's scoring rules.
  • Any attempt to cheat, engage in unauthorized collaboration, manipulate submissions, or disrupt the competition may result in disqualification.
  • The organizers reserve the right to resolve disputes, enforce competition rules, and make final decisions regarding eligibility, judging, and results.
  • Participation is subject to available seats and organizer approval.

What to Bring

  • A laptop, charger and an extension chord.
  • Your curiosity, creativity, and enthusiasm and problem-solving mentality.

Why Participate?

  • Challenge yourself with algorithmic problems.
  • Competite with students and developers from different institutions and specializations.
  • Demonstrate your technical skills and compete for prizes.
